texts.zh:
一阵重力异常将我们的观测站晃离了[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的轨道，导致它短暂进入了行星的下层大气。

虽然我们的乘员没有受伤而且也恢复了原定轨道，但有人担心观测站可能会被地上的[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发现。

只有时间知道我们是否暴露，以及这会对他们的社会造成何等影响。
texts.en:
A gravitational anomaly knocked our observation post over [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] out of orbit, causing it to briefly drop into the planet's lower atmosphere.

While our crew are unharmed and our original trajectory has been restored, there are concerns that the station could have been detected from the surface by the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Only time will tell if we have been exposed to the locals, and to what extent that will impact their society.

texts.zh:
我们的观测站在落入[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]下层轨道时被原始的成像科技记录了下来。除了目击证据，这些照片也启发了一些国家建造“登天之梯”以进一步调查研究。

尽管这是徒劳，各个民族国家之间的竞争导致了不稳定。在民族自豪感和资源稀缺的推动下，在完成第一个“阶梯”的竞赛中，旧有的紧张关系重新燃起。
texts.en:
Primitive image capturing technology managed to record our observation post while it was in low orbit above [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Alongside eyewitness testimonies, these photographs have inspired some nations to build "ladders to heaven" in order to investigate further.

While this is obviously a futile effort, competition between nation states is having a destabilizing effect. Old tensions are flaring up in the race to complete the first "ladder", fueled by national pride and scarcity of resources.

texts.zh:
如果我们能销毁他们关于我们存在的证据，那也许能在失控之前缓和紧张局势。

这种[Root.GetPreFTLUpper]政治实体之间的外交姿态也可以作为一个很有趣的社会学研究案例，尽管它还有可能成为暴力升级的导火索。
texts.en:
If we can discredit their evidence of our own existence, we may be able to defuse tensions before the situation gets out of [Owner.GetSpeciesHandName].

Alternatively, this diplomatic posturing between [Root.GetPreFTLUpper] political powers could be an interesting sociological case study, albeit one that comes with the risk of violent escalation.

texts.zh: 即将到来的混乱应该是一个极好的研究机会。
texts.en: The impending chaos should make for an excellent research opportunity.

tooltips.zh: 观测站的£society£社会学研究产出翻倍
tooltips.en: The £society£ Society Research output from the observation post is doubled

texts.zh:
我们的特工已经成功地推翻了我们在[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上存在的证据。

随着图像被揭穿，目击者的可信度被毁，“通天之梯”的建设已经停止。这两个曾经分裂的国家为自己被认为愚蠢而感到尴尬，他们已承诺追求理性的探索和科学的方法。

随着新一波学者聚集在一起，“天空城堡”神话的面纱被揭开，梯子的建筑工地已被改造成了高等教育中心。
texts.en:
Our operators have successfully discredited the evidence of our existence on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

With the images debunked and the eyewitnesses' credibility destroyed, construction of the "ladders to heaven" has stopped. Embarrassed by their perceived foolishness, the once-divided nations have made a commitment towards the pursuit of rational inquiry and the scientific method.

The building sites for the ladders have been repurposed into centers of higher learning, as a new wave of scholars come together to debunk the myths of the "Sky Citadel".

tooltips.zh:
[event_target:pre_ftl_country.GetName]向下一个时代进展50%
[event_target:pre_ftl_country.GetName]成为唯物主义。
tooltips.en:
[event_target:pre_ftl_country.GetName] makes 50% progress towards the next age
[event_target:pre_ftl_country.GetName] becomes Materialist.

texts.zh:
在建设“通天之梯”的过程中，[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[Root.GetPreFTLLower]国家之间的紧张局势导致了一场席卷全球的冲突。为了争夺日益减少的资源，这场持续两年的被称为“天梯大战”的大屠杀终于结束了。

和平条约的关键条款是组成统一战线对抗共同的敌人“天空堡垒”。随着[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始重建饱受战争蹂躏的星球，他们对未知的偏执和仇恨使得在未来与他们的互动更具挑战性。
texts.en:
In their efforts to construct "ladders to heaven," tensions between the [Root.GetPreFTLLower] nations of [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] led to an all-out global conflict. Fighting over ever-dwindling resources, the past two years of carnage known as the "Great Ladder Wars" have at last come to an end.

The key terms of the peace treaty are to present a united front against their common enemy, the "Sky Citadel." As the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] rebuild their war-torn world, their increased paranoia and hatred of the unknown will make future interactions with them more challenging.

tooltips.en: The £society£ Society Research output from the observation post returns to normal
